verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a rich set of official APIs an AI-native developer could build against — Query API, Raw Event Export API, Engage (profile) API, Feature Flags API, and even a JQL scripting interface — all first-party and documented at docs.mixpanel.com. However, the evidence pack never names concrete official client SDKs (e.g., language-specific libraries) or provides SDK-specific quickstart/reference docs, only API endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK library documentation/naming (e.g., Python/JS/Swift SDK references), code samples showing SDK usage rather than raw HTTP API calls, and independent/hands-on confirmation of SDK reliability.
